rows.note: Use this as the colloquial all-purpose choice for the act of pretending to be another person.

example.english: Their impersonation at the office party was very convincing.
example.traditional: 佢喺公司聚會扮人扮得好似樣。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 gung1 si1 zeoi6 wui6 baan6 jan4 baan6 dak1 hou2 ci5 joeng2

rows.note: Use this when the impersonation specifically involves falsely claiming to be someone else, often deceptively.

example.english: Someone’s impersonation of a bank employee was an attempt to trick me into giving up my personal information.
example.traditional: 有人冒充銀行職員打電話畀我，想套我嘅資料。
example.jyutping: jau5 jan4 mou6 cung1 ngan4 hong4 zik1 jyun4 daa2 din6 waa2 bei2 ngo5 soeng2 tou3 ngo5 ge3 zi1 liu2
